main_text.p: cebant, & spectatores oblectabant, maximè ante extructum theatrum, vt annotat Hesychius. Sed & frumenta ibi solita vendi, & tempore caritatis pauperioribus diuidi, ex Demosthenis oratione contra Phormionem didicimus: quare etiam controuersiæ omnes ad rem frumentariam, itemque ad debita quacunque ex causa alimenta pertinentes, ibidem disceptabantur. Pollux, libro v iii. Ὡς ὃ ὅπ τῷ σίτῳ δίκας ἐν τῷ Ωιδείῳ ἐδίκαζον. οἱ τὸς δὲ ὅπ ὃν, αἱ ὀφειλόμεναι προσφαί[?]. Inde est apud Demosthenem, δίκας σίτυ εἰς ᾠδεῖον δικάζεσθαι. in ea contra Neæram.
Βουδρομιῶνος μὲν τὰ μυστήρια. ) Intellige de maioribus initiis: nam minora mysteria Pyanepsione celebrabantur. Testis Demosthenes, Plutarchus & alij.
Πυανεψιῶνος ὁ ἀπαλήρια.) Testantur scholia Aristophanis in Acharnenses,aliiq; grammatici.

Ποσιδεῶνος ὁ τὰ κατ' ἀγρὸς Διονύσια.) Hæc sunt quæ minora Dionysia dicebantur: nam maiora mense Anthesterione peragebantur. Sed de his consulat lector vnicum illud seculi decus, Iosephum Scaligerum, in operis magni libro primo.

Μεριστεὸς ὁ γὰρ τὰς Θιώτας τὴν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ διαρπάζειν ἀπαλλάττεσθαι.) Merito semper nobis de mendo fuit hic locus suspectus. Nam quis eorum qui purius locuti sunt ἀπαλλάττειν τινά vnquam dixit, pro fugere procul ab aliquo? postulabat fanè loquendi consuetudo τινός: vel absolutè ἀπαλλάττεσθαι. vtrumque passim vsurpant scriptores antiqui: vt & ἀπαλλάττειν τινά, pro, à se remouere aliquem. illud autem primum, quod sciam, nunquâ. page.notes: Greek passages are set in a smaller italic or irregular hand and are transcribed from a low-resolution scan; the Greek words in the parenthetical opening lines of the Dionysia and Mysteria paragraphs, the Pollux citation and the Greek opening of the last paragraph are doubtful and should be checked against the original. The reading "ὃ ὅπ" and the words after "τῷ σίτῳ" are especially uncertain. The Greek in the last paragraph ("Μεριστεὸς" and "Θιώτας") is also doubtful. The word "Βουδρομιῶνος" may be "Βοηδρομιῶνος". The ligature "ꝛ" in the signature is read as "2". The source line ends with "ap-" and continues on the next page; the page has no catchword.
